bullets.text: Anbumani expressed concern that Pallikaranai marshland controversy continues under Chief Minister Vijay, and the office should monitor wetland drainage issues.
Two Class 10 students from Ambattur drowned in Puzhal lake while bathing, and the office should track safety measures around water bodies.
The meteorological department issued an orange alert for heavy rain in Chennai and yellow warnings for Thiruvallur, Kancheepuram, and Chengalpattu, requiring the office to stay alert.
Minister Dr. Kumar.R inspected and oversaw precautionary measures in Velachery as the northeast monsoon began, and the office should follow up on flood response.
Intense work is underway to clear stagnant floodwater in Velachery, and the office should watch drainage operations.
Motorists faced difficulties for two weeks on Velachery Main Road near the TNPDCL office because a dug-up portion for HT cables remained unrepaired, and the office should ensure road restoration.
Fire and rescue personnel safely rescued an 8-foot python that hid in a factory cement canal near Avadi, and the office should note wildlife safety actions.
Seeman urged the cancellation of the clinker grinding plant project in Tiruttani Karthikeyapuram due to environmental damage, and the office should monitor environmental grievances.
